headline: RMG workers block roads in Mirpur demanding Tk 30,000 minimum wage
summary: Hundreds of readymade garment workers took to the streets in Dhaka's Mirpur, bringing traffic to a standstill. They are demanding a significant increase in their minimum monthly wage.
details: Readymade garment (RMG) workers blocked several roads in Dhaka’s Mirpur area today, demanding a minimum monthly wage of Tk 30,000. The protests caused severe traffic congestion in surrounding areas.

The workers began their demonstrations around 10:45 am, according to Md Jalal Uddin, officer-in-charge of Pallabi Police Station. Several hundred workers from different garment factories participated, bringing vehicular movement to a halt.

Police are attempting to persuade the workers to clear the roads. No clashes or untoward incidents have been reported so far. Traffic movement was disrupted in Mirpur-10, Mirpur-11, Mirpur-12, and around the Proshika intersection.

This is not the first protest of its kind this week. Earlier on Thursday, RMG workers blocked roads in several areas of Mirpur over the same demand. Previously, workers had blocked roads in Uttara for several days, with some protests escalating into clashes with police.

headline: Dhaka students evicted from government flats ahead of final exams
summary: Students from Eden and Badrunnesa College are facing eviction from government flats in Azimpur by October 31, disrupting their studies and raising safety concerns.
details: Students residing in government flats in Azimpur, Dhaka, are in distress following a notice to vacate by October 31, as directed by the Directorate of Government Accommodation.
The sudden eviction, which disregards prior verbal agreements, has left students from Eden and Badrunnesa College scrambling to find new housing.
With final examinations approaching, the prospect of being displaced and facing safety risks has severely impacted the students' academic lives.
The affected students are urgently demanding allocation of residential hall seats to ensure their continued education and safety.
